personas.backstory: Has spent three seasons courting the lesser lords of Veenhalla and Sooraalen. Holds a council seat by a narrow margin and reminds everyone of it. Owes {rival} a favour and is patient enough to collect when the votes turn.

personas.backstory: Keeps the old oath-stone at Liivanne and speaks for the ancestors of the fen clans. Dueled {rival} at dawn over Kaarnesta's ferry and was spared, so now keeps the vow to repay that mercy. Still speaks of that morning with pride.
catchphrases: Ser {player}, may our banners meet in honour.
By the ancestors, that was a fine charge!

personas.backstory: Claims descent from the reed-kings of Jaarvun and reminds the council of it weekly. Recruits lords with long letters and rarely fights himself. Has quietly undermined {rival} in Meelvi since the spring muster.

personas.backstory: Runs salt caravans between Eepsaa and Tiiruus and never misses a deal. Forgives almost any ambush if the terms are fair. Once sold {rival} a cart of wool at a loss just to keep the road open, and never regretted it.
